final: WITH c AS (SELECT product_color AS color, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Products GROUP BY product_color), s AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM c), p AS (SELECT c.color, c.cnt, c.cnt * 1.0 / s.total AS ratio FROM c JOIN s ON s.total IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM p), k AS (SELECT p.cnt, p.ratio, p.cnt - a.avg_cnt AS excess FROM p JOIN a ON a.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL WHERE p.cnt > a.avg_cnt) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_kept, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess FROM k
